Dashboard

Gantt (Project-wide) — See the whole project over time.

Every task in the selected project (across all assignees) gathered into a single Gantt chart. Same UI as the personal Gantt, so you can adjust schedules right there too.

The whole project, laid out over time

Every task in the selected project (across all assignees) gathered into a single Gantt chart

Same UI as the personal Gantt

Parent-child tree, today line, progress line (lightning line), and drag the bar's edge to change dates (automatic dependency shifting works the same way here)

Filter however you like

Narrow things down by date range, assignee, yourself, status, or keyword search

Instant display from cache

If it's already fetched in Data Management, rendering happens with zero API calls

Adjust schedules for the whole project, on one screen.

See how someone's delay ripples to other tasks, all right there on the Gantt chart.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
